title: 네 시 삼십이 분
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time at 72 BPM in the key of G Major. A soft, intimate male vocal performs in a breathy, conversational style. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal melody. Subtle reverb is applied to the vocals to create a sense of space. The guitar maintains a consistent eighth-note rhythm throughout the passage.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
내 시 삼십 이 분 [acoustic guitar continues]
일곱 미터 있어
어둠 속 파란 빛
천장을 비춰
너도 잠이 안 와
아님 잠결이야
모든 상관없어
일곱 다 남아 있어
손이 떨리지 화면을 내려나
